# UIIconComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Clickable icon of a script UI, by the ID of a Scram or BBS icon, with colors for the normal, hovered and disabled state.

## Methods

### color {#color}

::: member

Sets the icon color.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xAARRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIIconComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIIconComponent) — this icon

:::

### hoverColor {#hovercolor}

::: member

Sets the icon color while the mouse is over it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xAARRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIIconComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIIconComponent) — this icon

:::

### disabledColor {#disabledcolor}

::: member

Sets the icon color while it is disabled, see [`enabled(boolean)`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent#enabled).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xAARRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIIconComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIIconComponent) — this icon

:::

### getColor {#getcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — icon color, as `0xAARRGGBB`

:::

### getHoverColor {#gethovercolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — icon color while hovered, as `0xAARRGGBB`

:::

### getDisabledColor {#getdisabledcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — icon color while disabled, as `0xAARRGGBB`

:::
